issue.title: artifacts_split PNG goldens snapshot the no-selection empty-details frame, so the split widths cover no selected detail
issue.description:
DISCOVERED BY: epic sase-ns.6.6.6 phase sase-ns.6.6.6.2, recorded as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP while rebaselining the eleven stale ACE PNG goldens (commit 24481abd4).

OBSERVATION: the four tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_split.py nodes --

  test_artifacts_split_mode_png_snapshot[narrow-size0-artifacts_split_narrow_120x40]
  test_artifacts_split_mode_png_snapshot[even-size1-artifacts_split_even_120x40]
  test_artifacts_split_mode_png_snapshot[wide-size2-artifacts_split_wide_120x40]
  test_artifacts_split_mode_png_snapshot[narrow-size3-artifacts_split_narrow_80x24]

-- never call select_entry_target, unlike the dedicated beads snapshot. Their goldens therefore capture the empty-details frame that renders when nothing is selected. That was not obvious until the rebaseline surfaced it: the accepted 2026-08-17 goldens are correct for what the tests currently do, so this is missing coverage rather than a stale golden, and the visual lane is green today.

IMPACT: the split-width goldens are the only pixel-level contract for how the details pane divides at narrow / even / wide, and right now none of them exercises a populated details pane. A regression in how selected-entry detail reflows at any split width would not be caught by this suite.

SCOPE: decide whether selected-detail coverage is wanted at each split width. If it is, teach the four split tests to select alpha-ready after load (mirroring the dedicated beads snapshot) and rebaseline ONLY those four goldens with --sase-update-visual-snapshots on the specific node IDs. Adding four new selected-state nodes alongside the existing empty-state ones is also acceptable and keeps both frames covered; prefer that if the empty-details frame is itself worth pinning.

HARD CONSTRAINT: never run just test-visual-update broadly. Closed bead sase-lo records that it rewrites every golden in the suite and silently absorbs unrelated drift.

VERIFICATION: a serial (-n 0 -m visual) run over tests/ace/tui/visual/ is green, and git status shows no golden modified outside the four (or the newly added ones). just install && just check green.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ny — the rebaseline task this was discovered under (worked as epic phase sase-ns.6.6.6.2, commit 24481abd4). It accepted these four goldens as correct-for-current-behavior; this task revisits what behavior they should capture, so read its close note first.
